aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, how do I install the public Python package and produce a first persistent APKG?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: I started at [the English llms.txt](https://ankiforge.dev/llms.txt). Its header already gives `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` (CPython 3.11+), and its Quickstarts entry, now titled [Generate Anki flashcards with Python](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/python-quickstart/index.md), is a one-hop route to the complete recipe. Install: `python -m venv .venv`, activate with `. .venv/bin/activate` (Windows: `.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`), then `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1` from the public PyPI package. Requirements: ordinary CPython 3.11 or later and a matching platform wheel; recorded release checks cover CPython 3.11–3.14. The quickstart's "verified environments" link targets the HTML page, so I read its Markdown form [Compatibility and releases](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/compatibility/index.md) (also listed under llms "Start here"): published native packages cover macOS arm64/x64, Linux x64 GNU/glibc and Windows x64; other Python implementations, free-threaded interpreters and subinterpreters need separate validation. First deck: save as `main.py` `from ankiforge import Project, Note, BuildOptions` / `project = Project('spanish', default_deck='Spanish')` / `project.add('es:hola', Note.basic('hola', 'hello'))` / `output = project.build(BuildOptions.to('spanish.apkg'))` / `print(output.artifact.path)`, then run `python main.py`. The result is the persistent `spanish.apkg` (its path is printed) containing hola → hello in deck Spanish; open it in Anki to check. Keep namespace `spanish` and note key `es:hola` stable for later edits. Exporting does not require Anki to be installed. I cross-checked the calls against [Python API](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/python-api/index.md): `Project(namespace, *, default_deck=None)`, `project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` returns a BuildOutput with a guaranteed persistent artifact, `ApkgArtifact` exposes `.path`, and persistent paths survive handle cleanup. This is a documented answer from the HTTP bodies; I did not install the wheel or run the program.
conclusions: llms.txt → python-quickstart/index.md is one hop; the retitled llms entry "Generate Anki flashcards with Python" and its description match the page's H1 and Description line, and the Markdown alone carries install commands, the CPython requirement and a complete first-deck program with persistent output and stable identity.
The supported wheel platforms are stated only on the compatibility page, which I reached as Markdown via llms "Start here" because the quickstart links the HTML page.
The Python API reference agrees with every call used by the quickstart (constructor keyword, BuildOptions.to, BuildOutput.artifact.path, persistent ownership).

aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, what is the public Node/TypeScript API surface, and how do asynchronous build/compare, reports, artifact ownership and prepared publication behave?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: From [the English llms.txt](https://ankiforge.dev/llms.txt) I followed API references → [Node and TypeScript API](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/node-api/index.md), Quickstarts → [Generate Anki flashcards with Node.js](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/node-quickstart/index.md) for installation, and Constraints → [Build and output guarantees](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/build-guarantees/index.md) for lifetime and publication. Install: Node.js 22.13+, `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`, which installs the public npm package and the matching native optional dependency; use `.mjs` for ESM or `require('ankiforge')` for CommonJS; TypeScript declarations ship with the package (tsconfig `target` ES2022, `module`/`moduleResolution` NodeNext, `strict`; `npx tsc`, then `node dist/main.mjs`). Surface: one `Project` authoring model — `new Project(namespace)`, `.defaultDeck(name)` (returns the project), `.add(key, note)` (atomic; duplicate keys fail), `.addAsset(media)`, `.clone()`, `.length`; immutable notes `Note.basic(front, back)`, `Note.cloze(text)`, `model.note().field(key, content)`, `note.deck().tag().tags()`; strings are Text, markup via `Content.html`, composition via `Content.sequence`; immutable models from `NoteType.builder(key).name().field(new Field(...)).template(new Template(...)).build()` with `GenerationRule.all/any/ankiDefault`, `builder.clozeField/css/asset`, or `await NoteType.fromBundle(path)`; media as owned snapshots `await Media.file(path)` / `await Media.bytes(Uint8Array, mime)` with `withExportName`, `.image()`, `.sound()` and a default 256 MiB limit; `Note.imageOcclusion(image).mask(Mask.rect(...)).mode(...).build()`. Build/compare: `await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` or `BuildOptions.temporary()` returns a BuildOutput owning a persistent or temporary artifact; `await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` returns a completed ComparisonReport even when policy blocks; options `.updateFrom(path)`, `.inspectLimits(limits)` and `.updatePolicy(policy)` (`new UpdatePolicy()` blocks High/Critical, `.failOn('medium')`, `.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` accepts a whole category; policy on a create-only build is an error). Async behaviour: build and compare run asynchronously on an owned project snapshot captured at invocation, so later edits cannot change that request; media reads and bundle loads also run on workers; ESM and CJS share one native module and class identities. Reports: BuildOutput exposes `.artifact`, `.report`, `.snapshot()`; BuildReport exposes `.counts`, `.baselineCounts`, `.durationMs`, `.diagnostics`, `.comparison` (a ComparisonReport or `null`) and `.snapshot()`, with no outcome and no file ownership; ComparisonReport exposes `.findings`, `.highestRisk`, `.policy`, `.diagnostics`, `.snapshot()`; snapshot JSON keeps Rust snake_case names such as `allows_publication`. Ownership: keep an artifact owner alive while using `.path`; `.clone()` creates another owner, `await .close()` releases one, the last temporary owner deletes the file, `await .persistTo(path)` returns a persistent artifact and leaves the original usable even on failure; persistent files survive owner cleanup and reports/snapshots never extend lifetime. Relative media and bundle paths anchor when the read is invoked; build destinations and baselines anchor when options are constructed. Errors are `ForgeError` subclasses with `kind`, `code`, `domain`, `causes`, `sourceDetails`, `details`; `BuildError.snapshot()` and `PersistError.publication` carry publication/durability facts; `ArtifactClosedError` and `NativeLoadError` cover closed owners and missing/stale native packages. Prepared publication is public in 0.3.1: `await project.preparePublication(BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').updateFrom('previous.apkg'))` builds, inspects and compares one private candidate; read `prepared.report` (immutable, owns no file), then `await prepared.publish()` publishes that same file; every attempt consumes the owner, later calls reject with `PreparedPublicationStateError` (`BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`, reason `consumed` or `closed`); `await prepared.close()` is idempotent and removes an unpublished candidate; closing after publish starts does not cancel it; options bind at preparation; a late durability failure can follow replacement, so inspect `PublicationSnapshot` facts (`path`, `stage`, `temporary`, durability) before retrying. This is a documented answer; I did not run Node programs.
conclusions: node-api/index.md alone answers the API surface, async snapshot semantics, report classes, artifact ownership and prepared publication; node-quickstart adds the install command and the statement that it brings the matching native optional dependency.
Ownership and prepared-publication semantics agree between node-api and build-guarantees (consumption on every attempt, idempotent close, binding at preparation, late durability facts).
Prepared publication and batch media are stated as public 0.3.1 features on both pages, but build-guarantees still heads that section "Prepared publication from source" (see open issues).

aiMachineReadReview.question: Starting only from the English llms.txt, how do I generate a deck from JSON with image and audio media, and review an answer-only update against the original distribution APKG?
aiMachineReadReview.answer: [The English llms.txt](https://ankiforge.dev/llms.txt) → Task guides → [Generate and update Anki decks from JSON](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/json-to-anki/index.md). Inputs: download [v1.json](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/v1.json), [v2.json](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/v2.json), [cell.png](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/cell.png) and [tone.wav](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/tone.wav) into `recipe/` (all four returned 200; both JSON files have namespace `biology-json`, deck `Biology` and notes `bio:cell`, `bio:nucleus`, `bio:membrane`; v2 changes only `bio:cell`'s back from "A unit of life" to "The basic structural and functional unit of life"; cell.png is an 836×471 PNG and tone.wav a 16 kHz mono PCM WAV). Choose one complete public 0.3.1 program: Rust 1.92+ (`cargo new json-deck`, `cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1`, `cargo add serde --features derive`, `cargo add serde_json`; `cargo run -- recipe output/rust`), Python CPython 3.11+ (venv, `python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`; `python main.py recipe output/python`) or Node 22.13+ (`npm init -y`, `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`, `npm install --save-dev typescript@6.0.3 @types/node@24.13.6`; `npx tsc main.mts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --outDir dist --types node`; `node dist/main.mjs recipe output/node`). Each program parses JSON itself, imports `Media.file('cell.png')` and `Media.file('tone.wav')`, builds the front as `Content.sequence([front, image.image(), audio.sound()])`, and adds `Note.basic(front, back)` under the JSON `id`. Flow: refuse an output directory that already holds v1/v2; build `v1.apkg`; compare the v2 project against v1 and write `comparison.json`, stopping if policy blocks; `prepare_publication`/`preparePublication(BuildOptions.to(v2).update_from(v1))`, write the prepared report's comparison to `review.json` (error if it is missing), re-check policy, then `publish()` and print `output/<language>/v2.apkg`. Expected: each release has 3 notes, 3 cards and 2 media files; comparison.json and review.json record `RISK.NOTE_CHANGED`, no added or removed notes and `policy.allows_publication: true`. Import v1 into Anki (Biology deck, three Basic cards, the cell image and the tone), then v2 and check that the first answer changed and three notes remain. Update conditions from [Update Anki decks with stable note IDs](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/updates/index.md) and [Build and output guarantees](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/build-guarantees/index.md): keep namespace `biology-json` and the three business keys stable (Anki Forge derives the GUID from that identity); the baseline must be the original distribution v1 APKG, never an Anki re-export, because the package's embedded `ankiforge-identity.json` evidence is not preserved by re-export; write candidates to a separate path; policy rejection does not replace the output and publication is per-file atomic replacement; importing does not delete notes omitted later, and client import settings, local edits and scheduling need testing on the target client. Media rules from [Add images and audio to Anki cards](https://ankiforge.dev/docs/media/index.md): media are immutable owned snapshots; typed `image()` needs `image/*` and `sound()` accepts `audio/*` or `video/*` (`NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID` otherwise); default per-asset import budget 256 MiB; a valid package does not prove playback on every client. This is a documented answer; I did not run the programs or import into Anki.
conclusions: The JSON guide is self-contained for all three SDKs with public 0.3.1 programs, shared inputs reachable over HTTP and explicit expected counts, risk code and import checks; the shared JSON bytes confirm the stated answer-only change.

The rewritten updates opening ("Publish corrections or new cards …") states the task and the client-side limits up front; its new Node/Python API links (#prepare-review-and-publish) resolve to existing ids.
Baseline, policy and publication semantics are consistent across json-to-anki, updates and build-guarantees.

aiMachineReadReview.question: 仅从中文 llms.txt 出发，Node/TypeScript 公开 API 有哪些，异步构建/比较、报告、产物所有权与预备发布如何工作？
aiMachineReadReview.answer: 从[中文 llms.txt](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/llms.txt)依次选择“API 参考”的[Node 与 TypeScript API](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/node-api/index.md)、“快速开始”的[用 Node.js 生成 Anki 卡片](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/node-quickstart/index.md)（安装）以及“限制与保障”的[构建与输出保证](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/index.md)（产物寿命与发布）。安装：Node.js 22.13 或更高版本，`npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` 会安装公开 npm 包及匹配的原生可选依赖；ESM 用 `.mjs`，CommonJS 用 `require('ankiforge')`；包内附带 TypeScript 声明（tsconfig：`target` ES2022、`module`/`moduleResolution` NodeNext、`strict`；`npx tsc` 后运行 `node dist/main.mjs`）。公开 API：唯一的 `Project` 内容编写模型——`new Project(namespace)`、`.defaultDeck(name)`（返回项目）、`.add(key, note)`（原子收集，重复键失败）、`.addAsset(media)`、`.clone()`、`.length`；不可变笔记 `Note.basic(front, back)`、`Note.cloze(text)`、`model.note().field(key, content)`、`note.deck().tag().tags()`；字符串成为 Text，标记用 `Content.html`，组合用 `Content.sequence`；不可变模型由 `NoteType.builder(key)…build()` 配合 `Field`、`Template`、`GenerationRule.all/any/ankiDefault` 及 `builder.clozeField/css/asset` 创建，或用 `await NoteType.fromBundle(path)` 从 `template-bundle-v2` 加载；媒体是拥有所有权的快照 `await Media.file(path)` / `await Media.bytes(Uint8Array, mime)`，支持 `withExportName`、`.image()`、`.sound()`，默认限制 256 MiB；图片遮挡用 `Note.imageOcclusion(image).mask(Mask.rect(...)).mode(...).build()`。构建与比较：`await project.build(BuildOptions.to(path))` 或 `BuildOptions.temporary()` 返回拥有持久或临时产物的 BuildOutput；`await project.compare(CompareOptions.against(path))` 即使策略阻止也返回完成的 ComparisonReport；选项 `.updateFrom(path)`、`.inspectLimits(limits)`、`.updatePolicy(policy)`（`new UpdatePolicy()` 阻止 High/Critical，`.failOn('medium')` 改阈值，`.allow('RISK.NOTE_REMOVED')` 放行整个类别；仅新建构建上设置策略会报错）。异步行为：build 与 compare 异步运行，使用调用时捕获并拥有所有权的项目快照，之后的编辑不会改变该请求；媒体读取与模板包加载也在工作线程执行；ESM 与 CJS 共享同一原生模块和类身份。报告：BuildOutput 提供 `.artifact`、`.report`、`.snapshot()`；BuildReport 提供 `.counts`、`.baselineCounts`、`.durationMs`、`.diagnostics`、`.comparison`（ComparisonReport 或 `null`）和 `.snapshot()`，没有结果或文件所有权；ComparisonReport 提供 `.findings`、`.highestRisk`、`.policy`、`.diagnostics`、`.snapshot()`；快照 JSON 沿用 Rust 的 snake_case 字段，如 `allows_publication`。所有权：使用 `.path` 时保持产物所有者存活；`.clone()` 创建独立所有者，`await .close()` 释放所有者，最后一个临时所有者删除文件；`await .persistTo(path)` 返回持久产物，失败时原所有者仍可用；持久文件在所有者清理后仍在，报告与快照不会延长文件寿命。相对媒体与模板包路径在调用读取时锚定，构建目标与基线在创建构建选项时锚定。错误均继承 `ForgeError`，提供 `kind`、`code`、`domain`、`causes`、`sourceDetails`、`details`；`BuildError.snapshot()` 与 `PersistError.publication` 记录发布与持久性事实；`ArtifactClosedError`、`NativeLoadError` 分别表示使用已关闭所有者和原生包缺失/不兼容/陈旧。预备发布已包含在公开 0.3.1 中：`await project.preparePublication(BuildOptions.to('next.apkg').updateFrom('previous.apkg'))` 构建、检查并比较一个私有候选包；读取 `prepared.report`（不可变、不拥有文件）后，`await prepared.publish()` 发布同一文件；每次尝试都会消耗所有者，重复调用以 `PreparedPublicationStateError`（`BUILD.PREPARED_UNAVAILABLE`，reason 为 `consumed` 或 `closed`）拒绝；`await prepared.close()` 幂等，并清理未发布的候选包；发布开始后关闭不会取消；选项在预备调用时绑定；成功替换后仍可能发生晚期持久性失败，重试前应检查 `PublicationSnapshot`（`path`、`stage`、`temporary`、持久性）。以上为文档答案，我没有运行 Node 程序。

openIssues.summary: node-api still ends its prepared-publication section with "Use protocol 6 binaries with these wrappers" (zh: "此包装层使用协议 6 二进制") without explanation. The Node quickstart does say that `npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1` installs the matching native optional dependency, which mitigates this for an agent that also reads it, but an agent answering from the API reference alone may invent a binary-selection step.

The Project table says `.defaultDeck(name)` returns the project but omits that `.add(key, note)` does too, although the prepared-publication example chains `new Project(...).add(...)` (the binding source declares `add(...): this`).

The Node and Python prepared-publication examples publish when `report.comparison` is null/None, whereas the JSON guide treats a missing comparison on an updateFrom preparation as an error. publish() still enforces policy, so this is an inconsistency of pattern, not a safety gap.

aiMachineReadReview.question: 仅从中文 llms.txt 出发，如何从 JSON 生成含图片和音频的牌组，并以原始分发 APKG 为基线检查仅修改答案的更新？

[v1.json](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/v1.json)、[v2.json](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/v2.json)、[cell.png](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/cell.png)、[tone.wav](https://ankiforge.dev/generated/recipes/json-to-anki/tone.wav) 放入 `recipe/`（四个共享文件本次 HTTP 均返回 200；两份 JSON 的命名空间为 `biology-json`、牌组为 `Biology`、笔记为 `bio:cell`、`bio:nucleus`、`bio:membrane`；v2 只把 `bio:cell` 的答案由 “A unit of life” 改为 “The basic structural and functional unit of life”；cell.png 为 836×471 PNG，tone.wav 为 16 kHz 单声道 PCM WAV）。任选一份固定公开 0.3.1 的完整程序：Rust 1.92+（`cargo new json-deck`、`cargo add ankiforge@0.3.1`、`cargo add serde --features derive`、`cargo add serde_json`；`cargo run -- recipe output/rust`）、Python CPython 3.11+（虚拟环境，`python -m pip install ankiforge==0.3.1`；`python main.py recipe output/python`）或 Node 22.13+（`npm init -y`、`npm install --include=optional ankiforge@0.3.1`、`npm install --save-dev typescript@6.0.3 @types/node@24.13.6`；`npx tsc main.mts --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --outDir dist --types node`；`node dist/main.mjs recipe output/node`）。程序自行解析 JSON，用 `Media.file` 导入 cell.png 与 tone.wav，以 `Content.sequence([front, image.image(), audio.sound()])` 组成正面，并以 JSON `id` 为键加入 `Note.basic(front, back)`。流程：输出目录已含 v1/v2 时拒绝；构建 `v1.apkg`；用 v2 项目对 v1 比较并写出 `comparison.json`，策略阻止则停止；`prepare_publication`/`preparePublication(BuildOptions.to(v2).update_from(v1))`，把预备报告中的比较写入 `review.json`（缺失则报错），再次检查策略后 `publish()`，输出 `output/<language>/v2.apkg`。预期：每个版本 3 条笔记、3 张卡片、2 个媒体文件；comparison.json 与 review.json 记录 `RISK.NOTE_CHANGED`、无新增或移除笔记、`policy.allows_publication: true`。先把 v1 导入 Anki（Biology 牌组三张 Basic 卡片、细胞图片与合成音），再导入 v2，确认第一个答案已变而仍为三条笔记。更新条件见[用稳定笔记 ID 更新 Anki 牌组](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/updates/index.md)和[构建与输出保证](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/build-guarantees/index.md)：保持命名空间 `biology-json` 和三个业务键不变（Anki Forge 由该身份派生 GUID）；基线必须是原始分发的 v1 APKG，不能用 Anki 重新导出的文件，因为包内 `ankiforge-identity.json` 身份证据不会随重新导出保留；候选包写到独立路径；策略拒绝不会替换输出，发布是单文件原子替换；导入不会删除后续包中省略的笔记，导入设置、本地编辑和调度需在目标客户端测试。媒体规则见[为 Anki 卡片添加图片与音频](https://ankiforge.dev/zh-cn/docs/media/index.md)：媒体是不可变的自有快照；类型化 `image()` 要求 `image/*`，`sound()` 接受 `audio/*` 或 `video/*`（否则 `NOTE.MEDIA_USAGE_INVALID`）；默认每个资源 256 MiB 导入预算；有效媒体包不代表所有客户端都能播放。以上为文档答案；我没有运行程序，也没有导入 Anki。
